newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNCC up 12 pct on road project news.
newsitem.headline: PNCC up 12 pct on road project news.

text.p: The Philippine National Construction Corp gained 1.50 pesos, or 12 percent, to 14 pesos at midession on Tuesday on news it signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with a Filipino-Malaysian group for a major road project, brokers said.
"People like PNCC because of its projects and its turnaround," said Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc.
PNCC reported it signed a MOU with the Ireka Group comprising of Ireka Construction Berhad, EEI Corp and J.E. Manalo, a local construction firm.

The Ireka Group expressed interest to undertake the financing, design and construction of a road project, an extension of the Metro Manila Expressway. Under the MOU, the Ireka Group will prepare and submit a feasibility study to PNCC.
If acceptable, PNCC will negotiate with the Ireka Group for a joint venture agreement.
Some 381,600 PNCC shares were traded in midsession.
